verdict: HTML approved, final generated-export review only. In all six screenshots the text is readable. At 1280 the columns are in the right order (Hebrew on the right, English on the left, rows aligned). At 390 each pair stacks Hebrew first, then English. The closing paragraph 'אתה נגלית בענן כבודך … ובקול שפר עליהם הופעת' is shown in full in every profile, and so is its English, 'Thou hast revealed Thyself … didst Thou appear to them.', in documentary and expanded. The colophon (title, contributors, licences) follows in every profile. The browser QA summaries show no errors, no duplicate IDs and no broken internal links, and scrollWidth matches the viewport at both widths for all three files, so there is no horizontal overflow. The equivalence claims (only canonical-URI and empty-anchor metadata changed in the HTML, no visible, layout or control changes, print TeX identical or differing only in ignored leading indents, PDF binaries preserved) are taken as reported by local machine QA and were not checked independently. The earlier PDF visual approval still holds because the three PDF binaries are reported unchanged. No findings block release. This review does not approve any implementation code, and the comparison script was not reviewed. No edits were made.
